function.arguments: {"message":"If the SSO configuration now points to an identity‑provider domain you don’t recognise, treat it as a possible admin‑level compromise. arguments.message: If the SSO configuration now points to an identity‑provider domain you don’t recognise, treat it as a possible admin‑level compromise. An admin who still has access should immediately revert the SSO setting (or disable it) in **Settings → Security → SSO** to point back at the correct provider. After doing that, report the change to Meridian support so a reviewer can investigate when and how the setting was altered and which account made the change.
